welcomeBody: A daily record of food and health, so you and your clinician can see what actually happens between visits. It keeps a record. It does not give treatment advice.
consentBody: You decide what to enter. In this demo everything stays in this browser’s local storage — there is no server and nothing is uploaded. In the Android app, entries are encrypted on the phone. No name, address, government ID or contact list is collected. You can erase everything at any time.
consentCheck: I have read this and understand this browser demo is not for real clinical records.
onboardStorage: Stored only in this browser. No account, no upload.
errMed: Give each medicine a name, or remove the empty row.
noMeds: No medicines recorded in your profile.
vitalsHint: Fill in only what you measured. Blank means not measured — that is information too.
notePh: A symptom, a meal out, a missed walk…
estimateNote: Ranges collapsed to a representative value. For patterns, not calorie counting.
autoSave: Changes save as you type, only on this device.
saveFailed: Could not save in this browser. Storage may be full or blocked.
searchPh: Search dish in English or Hindi
libraryNote: 83 regional dishes. Portions are household measures, not weights.
historyHint: A filled square means a record exists. Tap any day to look or edit.
completenessHint: Days with food, medicine status (when prescribed) and at least one measurement, divided by 21. Counted from saved entries, not memory.
insightsCaveat: These are observations about your own entries — not a diagnosis and not treatment advice.
insightsEmpty: Keep a record for about a week. Patterns need at least four paired days before anything is shown.
languageHint: Display only. Record values are stored as stable codes, so switching never rewrites a day.
exportsHint: Files are generated in this browser and downloaded to your device. Nothing is uploaded.
exportMetricsDesc: One row per day: readings, medicines, estimates.
exportFoodDesc: One row per dish, with English dish names.
exportBackupDesc: Profile and every day, with a schema version.
exportFhirDesc: LOINC vitals, UCUM units, Consent and Provenance.
exportPrintDesc: One page, English, generated from your own record.
sampleBody: Fill a realistic fortnight so you can try history, progress and exports without typing. It replaces this demo’s current records.
eraseBody: Deletes this demo’s profile, records and settings from this browser. It cannot be undone.
eraseConfirmBody: This removes the profile, every day and every setting from this browser. It cannot be undone.
aboutBody: Khai Tracker 1.0.0 (browser demo). Built by Khai Foods Pvt Ltd, Jamshedpur. Product owner: Biswajit Roy Bardhan.
demoOnly: Demo only · not a medical device · not for real clinical records.
noDataToast: No days recorded yet — add a day first.
printHint: In the print dialog choose “Save as PDF” for a one-page summary.
planIntro: A draft for a dietitian to review, built only from your own logged days. Illustrative — not advice.
planEmpty: Log about a week of food and readings first. A draft needs at least four paired days.
planNotAdvice: Illustrative only. Not advice, not a diagnosis. Do not change your food or medicines because of this draft — a qualified clinician decides.
planEditHint: Editing happens with the clinician in the review meeting; this demo records the decision only.
planLowConfidence: Low confidence — only a few paired days.
escalateBody: Raised readings are flagged for a conversation. The app never diagnoses or changes a prescription.
escalateNone: No threshold flags in the recent record.
planConfidenceBody: Food values are household-portion estimates shown as ranges, not weighed measurements. Pattern drafts come from a few paired days in one person — they are prompts for a clinician, not findings.
planPaired: Built from {n} days that have both food and a reading.
hospitalIntro: A design sketch of the hospital layer built around the same record. The cohort below is synthetic — no real patients, no hospital connection, no clinical decisions.
hospitalCaveat: Illustration only. Synthetic cohort and sample actions. Nothing here is deployed, and no real patient data is shown.
roleCoordinatorDesc: Sees cohort completeness, the review queue and the audit trail. Cannot change a prescription.
roleClinicianDesc: Sees the review pack for assigned participants, with flags and draft items linked to source days.
rolePharmacistDesc: Sees the medication discrepancy queue and the prescribed → dispensed → taken checkpoints.
hospPackIntro: Draft points and flags for the selected record, with the reasoning left visible.
hospPackEmpty: Log about a week in the participant app to see a review pack here.
hospAuditEmpty: Actions in this demo appear here.
hospitalLinkHint: A labelled illustration of the hospital layer — not a live system.
